'''Maria Leptin''' (born 15 September 1954) is a German [[developmental biology|developmental biologist]] and [[immunology|immunologist]], and the current president of the [[European Research Council]]. She was the director of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] from 2010 to 2021.

== Education ==
Leptin studied [[mathematics]] and [[biology]] at the [[University of Bonn]] and the [[Heidelberg University]].<ref name="erc"/> Initially planning to become a teacher, she decided to pursue a [[PhD]] in 1979 at the [[Basel Institute for Immunology]] after a practical taught by researchers from the institute.<ref name="node">{{cite web |title=An interview with Maria Leptin |url=https://thenode.biologists.com/an-interview-with-maria-leptin/interview/ |publisher=[[The Company of Biologists#Community sites|The Node]] |access-date=19 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210812142459/https://thenode.biologists.com/an-interview-with-maria-leptin/interview/ |archive-date=12 August 2021 |date=16 July 2013}}</ref> She was supervised by Fritz Melchers<ref name="embo">{{cite web |title=The EMBO Director |date=22 March 2021 |url=https://www.embo.org/about-embo/leadership-and-governance/maria-leptin/ |publisher=European Molecular Biology Organization |access-date=17 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210817153539/https://www.embo.org/about-embo/leadership-and-governance/maria-leptin/ |archive-date=17 August 2021}}</ref> and studied [[B-cell]] activation and maturation into [[plasma cells]] as part of the [[immune response]] to [[infections]].<ref name="dmm">{{cite journal |last1=Kain |first1=Kristin H. |title=Embracing new ideas: an interview with Maria Leptin |journal=[[Disease Models & Mechanisms]] |date=2010 |volume=3 |issue=3–4 |pages=136–137 |doi=10.1242/dmm.005454  |doi-access=free|pmid=20212080 |s2cid=196618574 |url=https://journals.biologists.com/dmm/article/3/3-4/136/2346/Embracing-new-ideas-an-interview-with-Maria-Leptin |access-date=19 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210819154808/https://journals.biologists.com/dmm/article/3/3-4/136/2346/Embracing-new-ideas-an-interview-with-Maria-Leptin |archive-date=19 August 2021|url-access=subscription }}</ref> She completed her PhD in 1983.<ref name="cologne"/>

== Career ==
=== Academic research and teaching positions ===
After her [[PhD]], in 1984, Leptin joined Michael Wilcox's group at the [[MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology]] (LMB) in [[Cambridge]] as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]]. It is here that she became involved in [[developmental biology]], studying the role of position-specific [[integrins]] in the [[embryonic development]] of ''[[Drosophila]]''.<ref name="bwhealth"/><ref name="cologne"/><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wilcox |first1=Michael |last2=Leptin |first2=Maria |title=Tissue-specific modulation of a set of related cell surface antigens in Drosophila |journal=Nature |date=1985 |volume=316 |issue=6026 |pages=351–354 |doi=10.1038/316351a0 |pmid=19288611 |bibcode=1985Natur.316..351W |s2cid=4330028 |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/316351a0 |access-date=23 August 2021|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Leptin |first1=Maria |last2=Bogaert |first2=Thierry |last3=Lehmann |first3=Ruth |last4=Wilcox |first4=Michael |title=The function of PS integrins during Drosophila embryogenesis |journal=[[Cell (journal)|Cell]] |date=1989 |volume=56 |issue=3 |pages=401–408 |doi=10.1016/0092-8674(89)90243-2 |pmid=2492451 |s2cid=24661684 |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0092867489902432 |access-date=23 August 2021|url-access=subscription }}</ref> In 1988, she became a staff scientist at LMB.<ref name="cologne"/>

Leptin's years at LMB raised her interest in cell shape, early [[Cell migration|cell movement]] and [[gastrulation]],<ref name="dmm"/> the last of which she began researching in 1989 during her brief stay at Patrick O'Farrell's group at the [[University of California, San Francisco]] as a [[Visiting scholar|guest scientist]].<ref name="cologne"/><ref name="embo"/> Afterwards she moved to the [[Max Planck Institute for Developmental Biology]] in [[Tübingen]], [[Germany]], leading a research group focused on gastrulation<ref name="erc"/> until 1994 when she became a [[professor]] at the [[University of Cologne]], Institute of Genetics, a position she is still holding.<ref name="ae">{{cite web |title=Maria Leptin |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Leptin_Maria |publisher=[[Academia Europaea]] |access-date=24 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210720061958/https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Leptin_Maria |archive-date=20 July 2021}}</ref> She is also leading a research group at Cologne,<ref>{{cite web |title=Leptin lab members at the Institute for Genetics, University of Cologne |url=http://www.uni-koeln.de/math-nat-fak/genetik/groups/Leptin/lep_peoples.htm |publisher=[[University of Cologne]] |access-date=24 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210824155602/http://www.uni-koeln.de/math-nat-fak/genetik/groups/Leptin/lep_peoples.htm |archive-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> which initially continued her study on gastrulation,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Barrett |first1=Kathy |last2=Leptin |first2=Maria |last3=Settleman |first3=Jeffrey |title=The Rho GTPase and a putative RhoGEF mediate a signaling pathway for the cell shape changes in Drosophila gastrulation |journal=Cell |date=1997 |volume=91 |issue=7 |pages=905–915 |doi=10.1016/s0092-8674(00)80482-1 |pmid=9428514 |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Seher |first1=Thomas C. |last2=Leptin |first2=Maria |title=Tribbles, a cell-cycle brake that coordinates proliferation and morphogenesis during Drosophila gastrulation |journal=[[Current Biology]] |date=2000 |volume=10 |issue=11 |pages=623–629 |doi=10.1016/s0960-9822(00)00502-9 |pmid=10837248 |doi-access=free |bibcode=2000CBio...10..623S }}</ref> but later shifted to the development of the ''Drosophila'' [[respiratory system]].<ref name="dmm"/><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Baer |first1=Magdalena M. |last2=Bilstein |first2=Andreas |last3=Leptin |first3=Maria |title=A clonal genetic screen for mutants causing defects in larval tracheal morphogenesis in Drosophila |journal=[[Genetics (journal)|Genetics]] |date=2007 |volume=176 |issue=4 |pages=2279–2291 |doi=10.1534/genetics.107.074088 |pmid=17603107 |pmc=1950631 }}</ref> Eventually, Leptin started using [[zebrafish]] as a [[model organism]] to study the [[innate immune system|innate immune response]].<ref name="dmm"/><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Stein |first1=Cornelia |last2=Caccamo |first2=Mario |last3=Laird |first3=Gavin |last4=Leptin |first4=Maria |date=2007 |title=Conservation and divergence of gene families encoding components of innate immune response systems in zebrafish |journal=[[Genome Biology]] |volume=8 |issue=11 |page=R251 |doi=10.1186/gb-2007-8-11-r251 |pmid=18039395 |pmc=2258186 |doi-access=free }}</ref>

Subsequently, she had two more experiences as a [[visiting scholar|visiting professor]], the first at the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École Normale Supérieure]] in [[Paris]] in 2001 and the second as [[visiting scholar|visiting scientist]] at the [[Wellcome Sanger Institute]] in [[UK]] between 2004 and 2005.<ref name="erc"/><ref name="cologne"/>

In 2009, Leptin was appointed the director of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]],<ref name="emboappoint"/> a role she took up in January 2010.<ref name="embo"/> She also set up a research group at the [[European Molecular Biology Laboratory]] in [[Heidelberg]], which studies the factors determining cell shape in ''Drosophila''<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rauzi |first1=Matteo |last2=Krzic |first2=Uros |last3=Saunders |first3=Timothy E. |last4=Krajnc |first4=Matej |last5=Ziherl |first5=Primož |last6=Hufnagel |first6=Lars |last7=Leptin |first7=Maria |title=Embryo-scale tissue mechanics during Drosophila gastrulation movements |journal=[[Nature Communications]] |date=2015 |volume=6 |article-number=8677 |doi=10.1038/ncomms9677  |doi-access=free|pmid=26497898 |pmc=4846315 |bibcode=2015NatCo...6.8677R }}</ref> and the ''in vivo'' imaging of innate immune response in zebrafish.<ref>{{cite web |title=Leptin Group |url=https://www.embl.org/groups/leptin/ |publisher=European Molecular Biology Laboratory |access-date=26 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210826144856/https://www.embl.org/groups/leptin/ |archive-date=26 August 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kuri |first1=Paola |last2=Ellwanger |first2=Kornelia |last3=Kufer |first3=Thomas A. |last4=Leptin |first4=Maria |last5=Bajoghli |first5=Baubak |title=A high-sensitivity bi-directional reporter to monitor NF-κB activity in cell culture and zebrafish in real time |journal=[[Journal of Cell Science]] |date=2017 |volume=130 |issue=3 |pages=648–657 |doi=10.1242/jcs.196485 |pmid=27980067 |s2cid=9575555 |doi-access=free }}</ref>

Leptin had a stay at the [[University of Oxford]] in 2018, where she was a visiting professor of [[Cell biology|Cell]] and Developmental Biology.<ref name="colognelab"/>

=== Presidency of the European Research Council ===
In June 2021, Leptin was appointed as the next president of the [[European Research Council]], starting from 1 October 2021.<ref name="erc"/><ref name="ercappoint" /><ref>{{cite magazine |last=Bartoloni |first=Mia |date=9 July 2021 |title=Movers and Shakers &#124; 9 July 2021 |url=https://www.theparliamentmagazine.eu/news/article/movers-and-shakers-9-july-2021 |magazine=[[The Parliament Magazine]] |access-date=14 July 2021 |archive-date=14 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210714113704/https://www.theparliamentmagazine.eu/news/article/movers-and-shakers-9-july-2021}}</ref><ref name="nature">{{cite journal |last1=Abbott |first1=Alison |title=Biologist to lead Europe's premier research funder |journal=[[Nature (journal)|Nature]] |date=6 July 2021 |doi=10.1038/d41586-021-01843-w |pmid=34230664 |s2cid=235757852 |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-021-01843-w |access-date=19 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210819144223/https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-021-01843-w |archive-date=19 August 2021|url-access=subscription }}</ref> It was announced in September, however, that she would delay taking up the new role to 1 November.<ref name="ercdelay">{{cite news |last1=Naujokaitytė |first1=Goda |title=New ERC president to take up post a month later than planned |url=https://sciencebusiness.net/news/new-erc-president-take-post-month-later-planned |access-date=20 October 2021 |work=Science&#124;Business |date=21 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211020145343/https://sciencebusiness.net/news/new-erc-president-take-post-month-later-planned |archive-date=20 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Maria LEPTIN |url=https://erc.europa.eu/erc_member/maria-leptin |publisher=European Research Council |access-date=20 October 2021 |archive-date=20 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211020145344/https://erc.europa.eu/erc_member/maria-leptin}}</ref> Unexpected changes to the grant schemes announced by Leptin — including barring most unsuccessful applicants from reapplying for minimum two years — have drawn criticism,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Leptin |first=Maria |date=16 April 2026 |title=ERC President explains stricter application measures amid rising demand for funding |url=https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/erc-president-explains-stricter-application-measures-amid-rising-demand-funding |access-date=26 April 2026}}</ref> with scholars, including various ERC panel members, arguing that these measures undermine the ERC’s mission, exclude innovative scientists, and weaken Europe’s global competitiveness in basic research.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Carmeliet |first=Peter |last2=De Strooper |first2=Bart |date=25 April 2026 |title=Letter to The President and Members of the European Research Council, The European Commission and Members of the European Parliament |url=https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/1mv3h0g1z7yvt8wo6v4kk/ERC-letter-final.pdf?dl=0&e=1&noscript=1&rlkey=65qu01e9o7371f0auv3nztdm9&st=v43eqido |access-date=26 April 2026 |website=Dropbox |language=en}}</ref>

=== Extra-academic positions ===
Other than academic appointments, Leptin was the president of the German Society for Developmental Biology from 1996 to 1997, a member of the advisory board of the German Genetics Society from 2008 to 2012, the president of the [[Initiative for Science in Europe]] from 2012 to 2017.<ref name="cologne"/> She was also a member of the board of trustees of the [[Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association]] from 2004 to 2009 and of the [[Babraham Institute]] between 2006 and 2009.<ref name="cologne"/> She served on the editorial board of ''[[Developmental Biology (journal)|Developmental Biology]]'' from 1996 to 2001 and ''[[Developmental Cell]]'' since 2001, as well as a co-editor of ''[[Mechanisms of Development]]'' and ''Gene Expression Patterns'' between 2002 and 2009.<ref name="cologne"/>

|url=https://www.mpi-cbg.de/institute/advisory-boards/ |publisher=[[Max Planck Institute of Molecular Cell Biology and Genetics]] |access-date=3 September 2021 Singapore]],<ref>{{cite web |title=MBI's Scientific Advisory Board |url=https://www.mbi.nus.edu.sg/about-mbi/scientific-advisory-board/ |publisher=[[National University of Singapore]] |access-date=3 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210520112138/https://www.mbi.nus.edu.sg/about-mbi/scientific-advisory-board/ |archive-date=20 May 2021}}</ref> and of the [[Institute of Molecular Biotechnology]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Scientific Advisory Board |url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/imba/scientific-advisory-board |publisher=[[Institute of Molecular Biotechnology]] |access-date=6 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210906145235/https://www.oeaw.ac.at/imba/scientific-advisory-board |archive-date=6 September 2021}}</ref> as well as on the University Council of the University of Cologne.<ref>{{cite web |title=University Council |url=https://portal.uni-koeln.de/en/university/organization/university-council |publisher=University of Cologne |access-date=3 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210812122738/https://portal.uni-koeln.de/en/university/organization/university-council |archive-date=12 August 2021}}</ref> She is also one of the directors of the Christiane Nüsslein-Volhard Foundation.<ref>{{cite web |title=Directors |url=https://cnv-stiftung.de/en/directors |publisher=Christiane Nüsslein-Volhard Foundation |access-date=3
